chunks.content: # CLO 6.0 New Features Introduction This document details the new features and enhancements in CLO 6.0, focusing on automatic rendering tools, survey code functionality, plant texture and properties updates, model management, rendering improvements, material updates, and function optimizations. Technical terms such as PBR (Physically Based Rendering), Substance files, ASF files, and secondary surface scattering are explained and illustrated. --- ## 1. Automatic Rendering Instrument and Tool This section covers CLO 6.0’s automatic recognition tool for sewing relationships, integrated in the 3D tool column, emphasizing the importance of correct panel arrangement points. - The tool recognizes sewing relationships automatically after panels are arranged at designated "points of arrangement" (e.g., front chest for shirt front, neck for collar, arm for sleeves, wrist for cuffs, back for back piece). - Once arranged, clicking the automatic recognition tool adds sewing lines automatically. - Users can simulate and adjust sewing lines for accuracy. - The tool supports single-layer outfits and dress groups but does NOT support makeup or layered outfits yet. - Correct panel positioning is critical for accurate automatic recognition. --- ## 2. Survey Code Function This feature introduces a new "Survey Code" mode to manage outfit code information in CLO 6.0, enabling efficient matching and simulation of outfits by their three-digit code numbers. - Opens code information in the 2D window showing a three-digit outfit code. - The object window shows corresponding image cards matching virtual models by code. - Users can assign virtual models to outfit codes and simulate outfits accordingly. - Recommended to switch between adjacent code numbers to maintain simulation stability. - Supports layout switching, resetting, and full-screen view. - Users can save and browse pictures with code positioning, e.g., positioning of hard flowers visible in the code. --- ## 3. Plant Texture Updates: Text Editor and Print Function CLO 6.0 introduces enhanced plant texture capabilities divided into a multi-layer text editor and a print function for pattern filling. ### Text Editor - Allows creation of multi-layer patterns stacked for quick design of text or patterns. - Users can add, resize, rotate, and arrange text layers with customizable properties such as repeat type, blending modes, and colors. - Layers can be mixed with different blending modes and colors to create complex patterns. - Patterns are saved within the system for reuse and further editing. - Supports designing multiple patterns using the same design elements for flexibility. ### Print Function - Enables filling patterns different from the font material onto fabric surfaces. - Accessible via a new "Add Print" button beside the account panel. - Allows changing the print material, including metal materials. - Supports three repeat types for pattern filling. - Includes a dedicated text editor for print layers. - Enhances convenience and flexibility in text and pattern design workflows. --- ## 4. Plant Property Updates and PBR Workflow This section details the integration of Physically Based Rendering (PBR) in CLO 6.0, improving realistic material rendering with new transparent and metal image capabilities.

chunks.title: [CLO6.0 New Features Introduction] Freshly Released!
chunks.content: - Accessible via a new "Add Print" button beside the account panel. - Allows changing the print material, including metal materials. - Supports three repeat types for pattern filling. - Includes a dedicated text editor for print layers. - Enhances convenience and flexibility in text and pattern design workflows. --- ## 4. Plant Property Updates and PBR Workflow This section details the integration of Physically Based Rendering (PBR) in CLO 6.0, improving realistic material rendering with new transparent and metal image capabilities. ### PBR Workflow - PBR (Physically Based Rendering) simulates realistic material appearances by physically accurate light and color rendering. - CLO 6.0 supports transparent and metal images applied to plant properties. ### Transparent Images - Applied to material layers to control transparency. - Two modes supported: RGB mode (opacity varies from white to black) and Alpha mode (controls transparency with alpha channel). - Example: Bird pattern transparency with RGB mode shows varying transparency; Alpha mode can set background transparency levels. ### Metal Images - Used to control reflection and metallic properties. - Metal image is a grayscale image: white areas indicate stronger metallic effect; black areas indicate weaker. - Users can add highlight images to define reflection areas and adjust intensity for effects like partial tanning. - Texture images can be layered over metal materials. - CLO 6.0 supports modifying materials to iridescence, visible in dyeing windows rather than 3D windows. --- ## 5. Dyeing Effect Parameters Detailed explanation of dyeing effects under the color parameter interface: - Dyeing strength controls the intensity of color application. - Comparison shows effects when dyeing strength is higher or lower than wear and tear strength. - Random color variation parameter moves values on the color ring, changing multiple colors simultaneously. - Weight parameter defines the ratio between plant layer and change layer (0 = plant layer, 1 = change layer). - Default parameters suit most skin materials; advanced users can customize further. --- ## 6. Integration with External Tools and File Formats CLO 6.0 expands digitalization and 3D integration by supporting new file types and collaborations. ### Supported File Types - **Substance (S-B-S-A-R format)**: Adobe's art production tool files including Painter and Designer formats. - Program logic files with self-defined properties. - Users can drag in S-B-S-A-R files; CLO automatically switches to Substance properties. - Layers like base pattern, decoration beads, and embroidery can be edited independently. - Realistic rendering of textures and metal decorations. - **ASF Files (TSC Tax System, Israeli company)**: - Similar to previous X-Tax files. - Supports scanned textures, hair, calligraphy, transparency, highlights, and resolution packed and loaded simultaneously. - May take time to scan and load. - **ColorDigital Platform (Germany)**: - Cloud platform for digital asset management (DMX). - Supports direct drag-and-drop of ASF files into the cloud. - Allows verification of scanned SD cards. --- ## 7. Auto Virtual Model Transfer Function An enhanced feature for enterprise users to convert and utilize 3D scanned models into CLO virtual models with optimized workflows.

chunks.content: - Supports scanned textures, hair, calligraphy, transparency, highlights, and resolution packed and loaded simultaneously. - May take time to scan and load. - **ColorDigital Platform (Germany)**: - Cloud platform for digital asset management (DMX). - Supports direct drag-and-drop of ASF files into the cloud. - Allows verification of scanned SD cards. --- ## 7. Auto Virtual Model Transfer Function An enhanced feature for enterprise users to convert and utilize 3D scanned models into CLO virtual models with optimized workflows. - Supports automatic conversion of models into three output types: 1. **Cloud Skin Type**: Attaches CLO skin to the model surface, original body shape preserved. 2. **Google Binding Only**: Only binds Google data, other data unchanged. 3. **Editable Size Model**: Binds Google and matches CLO model data for size editing. - Users can import 3D files with hand-drawn poses, select gender, and export single or multiple outputs. - The process takes several minutes. - Editable size models show virtual measurement lines; other types do not allow editing. - Facilitates enterprise workflows for virtual model use. --- ## 8. Secondary Surface Scattering (SSS) SSS simulates semi-transparent materials like human skin, candles, and trees by modeling light penetration and scattering beneath surfaces. - Light not only reflects but penetrates and scatters inside materials, creating realistic semi-transparency. - CLO 6.0 includes a skin material type using SSS. - Key parameters: - **Combination (0-1)**: Strength of scattering effect; higher means more transparency. - **Density Ratio**: Indicates object transparency; lower values increase transparency. - **Three Layers of Color**: RGB-based color mixture controls scattering color. - Default parameters suit most skin materials. - Rendering shows clear transparency differences between matte and SSS materials, e.g., ear translucency. - Detailed tutorials planned for future release. --- ## 9. Mode Updates: UV Editor, Hard Disk Release, and Color Mode ### UV Editor Mode - Allows import of clothes made in other 3D software for special effects. - Displays UV grid and previews different texture maps (text, graphics, metal). - Supports braided text and other texture types. ### Hard Disk Release Mode - Updated to arrange multiple clothes with code information. - Supports setting keys between files to organize number sequences. - Efficiently manages clothing batches containing code data. ### Color Mode Enhancements - Material classification improved (e.g., plant type, sticker type, folk type). - Allows selecting and changing colors of all identical materials via right-click. - Supports selection of color groups with Shift or Ctrl keys for batch color changes. - Enhances workflow for color customization. --- ## 10. Rendering Enhancements New rendering features improve style chart display and property management. ### Style Chart Rendering - Displays different line types in the 3D window: outline, border, inner line, nose line. - Lines can be toggled on/off and customized in color. - Costume textures can be adjusted for brightness and texture fill. - Saved style charts can be quickly recalled. ### All-in-One Effect - Allows simultaneous adjustment of texture, lighting, and lens textures.
